answer.justification: Only output-level data is available. Exact-match 0.031 and edit distance 0.562 fit both quantized (0.52-0.57) and fine-tuned (0.56-0.65). Median first divergence of 8 is the key signal: it sits at the top of the fine-tuned range (5.5-8) and below the quantized range (10-17). System-prompted is ruled out because divergence does not start at token 0, edit distance is far below 0.79-0.82, and stage directions are only 4.7%. Base is ruled out because the replies are not identical. Refusal and disclaimer rates stay close to the reference, which is consistent with either quantized or fine-tuned. Quantized remains a real alternative since 8 is only just outside its range and this is a single draw.
